description: Machine-contract fixture for Circle effective_scope semantics. Splits actor submit-payload (scope_circle_id only) from canonical reducer-output (tagged effective_scope on Event envelope and materialized object). Covers None->None, same-scope->same-scope, None->Some, Some->None, Some(A)->Some(B) rebind transitions plus negative cases. negative_cases also pin the accepted-Event / materialized-object closure: accepted Circle-scoped DataEvents MUST carry effective_scope, effective_scope MUST agree with scope_circle_id, the signed event_digest binds effective_scope, and content_encryption_floor=e2ee_required rejects plaintext content. See spec/v1/zh/models/circle.md §6.1 / §6.2 / §7 / §10.2.

submit_payload_shape.description: Actor-supplied input on ck.strand.create / ck.message.create / ck.morph.create / ck.relation.create / ck.space.* writes. MUST carry only scope_circle_id (id:circle | null). MUST NOT carry effective_scope.

canonical_reducer_output_shape.description: Reducer-stamped, immutable tagged scope written to Event envelope and materialized object cell. Two discriminated forms: kind=realm | kind=circle.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: none_to_none_noop
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=null -> scope_circle_id=null. No-op rebind; reducer MUST accept (idempotent same-scope), effective_scope stays {kind:realm}.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: same_circle_to_same_circle_noop
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=Some(A). No-op rebind; reducer MUST accept.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: none_to_circle_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=null -> scope_circle_id=Some(A). True rebind; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: circle_to_none_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=null. True rebind; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

scope_rebind_transition_cases.name: circle_a_to_circle_b_default_reject
scope_rebind_transition_cases.description: scope_circle_id=Some(A) -> scope_circle_id=Some(B). True rebind across circles; default reducer MUST reject with failed_precondition reason=scope_rebind_forbidden. Profile MAY enable audit-paired high-risk update.

negative_cases.name: submit_payload_carrying_effective_scope_rejected
negative_cases.description: Actor MUST NOT supply effective_scope in submit payload. Reducer MUST schema_violation with reason=effective_scope_reducer_managed.

negative_cases.name: scope_circle_id_targets_inactive_circle
negative_cases.description: scope_circle_id references a Circle with state != active. Reducer MUST failed_precondition reason=circle_not_active.

negative_cases.name: scope_circle_id_realm_mismatch
negative_cases.description: scope_circle_id references a Circle whose realm_id != object.realm_id. Reducer MUST schema_violation reason=circle_realm_mismatch.

negative_cases.name: accepted_event_missing_effective_scope
negative_cases.description: An accepted durable Circle-scoped Event (e.g. ck.message.create whose Strand scope_circle_id is set) MUST carry the reducer-stamped effective_scope on its envelope. An offline validator / cotest MUST reject an accepted event whose object is Circle-scoped but whose effective_scope is absent, otherwise the §9.3 'Circle scoped event not delivered to non-members' invariant cannot be deterministically replayed. event-envelope.schema.json carries effective_scope as a reducer-stamped field; this vector pins that accepted (post-reducer) Circle events MUST populate it.

negative_cases.name: effective_scope_mismatches_scope_circle_id
negative_cases.description: The reducer-stamped effective_scope MUST be derived from the object's scope_circle_id: scope_circle_id=null -> {kind:realm}; scope_circle_id=C -> {kind:circle, circle_id:C}. A materialized object / accepted event whose effective_scope.circle_id disagrees with its scope_circle_id is corrupt; reducer MUST schema_violation (effective_scope_reducer_managed) on write and a validator MUST reject on read.

negative_cases.name: seal_leaf_effective_scope_tamper
negative_cases.description: effective_scope is part of an Event's canonical bytes, so event_digest = H(canonical bytes) binds it directly. If a Seal later reports the DataEvent inside data_event_set_root, that root is an observational availability/projection proof, not control-plane finality. Mutating effective_scope after signing changes event_digest, so the recomputed digest no longer matches the signed event. Receivers MUST reject with digest_mismatch; this forbids silently re-scoping an accepted event and is why no separate scope field is added to seal.schema.json (the binding is the digest).

negative_cases.name: content_plaintext_under_e2ee_required
negative_cases.description: Realm.content_encryption_floor=e2ee_required requires every Strand/Message/Morph/Blob content effective_scope to be MLS-backed (Realm-default MLS or Circle MLS). A ck.message.create carrying plaintext content (or whose effective_scope resolves to a plaintext Circle with encryption_profile=none) MUST be rejected with failed_precondition reason=content_encryption_floor_violation.
